voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: The optic and the fiber must match the supplied profile. A pleasing glow is not a compatibility test.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for “optic and the fiber” as a pair. Give the word “profile” time to land before Photon's observation about the glow.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Single mode and multiple modes describe light propagation. They do not promise one or several independent payload channels.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Follow “single mode” and “multiple modes” into “light propagation.” Check whether “independent payload channels” is clear at the end.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: I can illuminate the connection. Delivering electrical power through that fiber is outside my job description.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for “electrical power” around 2.3–3.2 seconds and “fiber” around 3.6–3.9 seconds. Photon should still have space to land the job-description joke.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: After a change, inspect and measure again. The old reading can stay in the notebook as history.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for both actions after the change, “inspect and measure again,” before the old reading goes into the notebook.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Try the known pattern again over the repaired route. Compare what arrived with what was sent.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that “known pattern” is clear. Leave space between what arrived and what was sent so the comparison is easy to follow.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: A steady light, a fresh check, and a record someone else can follow. That is a promising morning.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: In the lasting-repair ending, follow “steady light,” “fresh check” and “a record someone else can follow” through the first 4.7 seconds.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Borrowed dawn is still dawn. Let us keep the temporary part written where nobody can miss it.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: In the temporary-repair ending, check “Borrowed dawn” around 0.4–1.3 seconds and the stress on “temporary” around 3.2–3.8 seconds.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: The light can wait. We know what is unresolved, and we have a safe place to begin again.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: In the safe-stop ending, listen for “unresolved” around 2.9–3.9 seconds and “safe place” around 4.5–5.3 seconds. Does Photon give the listener time to absorb both?

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Welcome to the Shell Market. Please compare the specifications before admiring the polish.
voices.learningIntent: Hermit identity; O09 evidence before cosmetics
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check Hermit's turn from the Shell Market welcome to “specifications” and the dry final word “polish.”

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: A shell that fits the cage is only a start. Check the supported physical profile, medium and required wavelength.
voices.learningIntent: O09 / T07; form factor alone insufficient
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for all three checks after the shell fits, especially the transition from “medium” to “required wavelength.”

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: S F P names a form factor here. The particular module tells you what it actually supports.
voices.learningIntent: C10; speak acronym clearly, no invented universal rate
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Hear three separate letters in S F P. Check that “form factor” and the module's actual support are distinct thoughts.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: The Chimera has a broader shell. Its lanes and breakout support still depend on the specified module profile.
voices.learningIntent: CH17 limitation; QSFP shape not capability guarantee
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check the name Chimera, then “lanes and breakout support.” Keep the final qualification about the specified module profile audible.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Keep delivered power separate from source power. This exercise supplies a budget at the endpoints.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for “delivered power” and “source power” separately. “At the endpoints” identifies which budget the exercise supplies.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Twelve, eleven and ten watts total thirty-three. This supplied thirty-watt budget is three watts short.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Follow twelve, eleven and ten watts to thirty-three, then a thirty-watt budget to a three-watt shortfall. Listen especially for the final s in “three watts” around 5.2–5.9 seconds.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Powered, yes. Communicating, not yet established. I have met many very well-lit broken links.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the short pause after “Powered, yes.” Keep “not yet established” clear before the aside about well-lit broken links.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: An adequate optical budget cannot rescue an incompatible optic and fiber pair. Check both.
voices.learningIntent: T07; compatibility not overridden by power
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that “incompatible optic and fiber pair” stays together, followed by the short instruction to check both.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: D B M is a power level. D B expresses a difference or ratio. Keep their labels attached to the numbers.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for D B M as three letters in the first sentence and D B as two in the second. Flag a swallowed letter, “power level,” or “difference or ratio.”

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Above sensitivity is not the whole test. Leave the stated reserve margin, and do not exceed the stated maximum receive level.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Pick out sensitivity near 0.6 seconds, reserve margin near 4.4 seconds and maximum receive level near 7.1 seconds. The word “exceed” carries the last limit.

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: Select the compatible parts for your chosen route. You need a repair kit, not the entire market.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for “compatible parts” and “your chosen route” before the repair-kit advice. Does Hermit leave time for the market joke?

voices.speaker: Hermit
voices.caption: The ledger is less glamorous than a lightning bolt. It is also rather better at adding watts.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that the ledger and lightning bolt get separate beats. The final “watts” lands around 5.7–6.7 seconds.
